item.title: It’s the last day to get a $350 gift card with your Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 preorder
item.summary: Samsung’s latest foldable Android phones, the Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra, and Flip 8, release tomorrow, August 7th. Today is the final day when you can place a preorder, and really the only reason we’re suggesting that is because you’ll get some freebies that will go away upon release.
